text: Completed benchmark evaluation of MedOptm clinical VLM with Prof. Raj Hakani; achieved 0.33 METEOR on clinical VQA under sub-2B parameter budget.
Selected for Amazon ML Summer School 2026 (6th Edition national engineering cohort) covering deep learning architectures and production multimodal systems.
Joined Xu Lab at Carnegie Mellon University as remote Research Intern, developing deep learning non-rigid registration pipelines for 3D cortical surface meshes.
First-author research paper accepted at ICMLDE 2025: Two-stage transfer learning with modified VGG16 achieving 97.88% multi-class brain tumor MRI accuracy.
Commenced Machine Learning Internship at Infosys Springboard, designing computer vision pipelines for ANPR plate recognition and ATCC vehicle classification.
Initiated undergraduate research on compact vision-language reasoning and convolutional token packing with Prof. Raj Hakani at Gujarat Technological University.
